sn22.128:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.128:2.1: idhāvuso sutavā ariyasāvako samudayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ samudayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti: vayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ …pe… samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.128:2.4: samudayadhamme saṅkhāre …pe… samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn22.128:2.5: vayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ …pe… samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
